cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Put It Back Quietly
cards.instruction: Return something you misplaced, used, or damaged without revealing why it needed restoring.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your plate is back in the cupboard. Set it down gently, please; rims chip when you drop one plate onto another.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Our plates are plain. That one has flowers.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then this is the serving plate. We distinguish serving pieces from place settings.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need all six plain plates for Sunday. Where's the sixth?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll supply six matching floral ones. Put the plain ones at the back, please. A proper table uses one service; let's get that right first.

reason: Replace ornamental storage philosophy with a practical handling correction, then make A complete-service instruction the immediate restoration priority instead of explaining the cover-up.
